title: Luca Learns to Sit
youtubeTitle: Luca vs. The Treat: Teaching Sit Step by Step (Puppy Training Tips)

scenes.shot: Wide. Luca zooms around the room, spins after his own tail and crashes into his platypus.
scenes.voiceover: Good morning. I have energy. All of it.

scenes.shot: Medium. Luca jumps at the human's legs and slides down, paws scrabbling.
scenes.voiceover: Hi! Hi! Did you know I'm here? HI!

scenes.shot: Close-up. The human holds a treat just out of reach. Luca stares at it.
scenes.voiceover: She has a treat. I do not have a treat. This is a crime.

scenes.text: Hold a treat right at his nose.

scenes.shot: Close-up. The treat appears right in front of his nose. He goes cross-eyed with love.
scenes.voiceover: Oh. Oh, hello. I would follow you anywhere.

scenes.text: Move it slowly up and back over his head.

scenes.shot: Side view. The treat moves up and back. His head tips back and his bottom starts to sink.
scenes.voiceover: Up... and back... my neck was not built for this.

scenes.shot: Medium. Patience runs out. He jumps for the treat, misses and slides back down.
scenes.voiceover: Plan B: just take it. ...Plan B has been cancelled.

scenes.text: The moment his bottom touches the floor: say "Yes!" and give the treat.

scenes.shot: Side view. His bottom plops onto the floor. The hand gives him the treat.
scenes.voiceover: Wait. My bottom touched the floor... and a snack appeared?!

scenes.shot: Quick cuts. Luca sits in the kitchen, the bathroom and in front of the fridge.
Medium. The human says Sit. Luca drops into a perfect sit before the hand even moves.
scenes.voiceover: She said the magic word. I'm basically a genius.

scenes.shot: Medium. Still sitting, Luca slowly falls asleep and tips over onto his platypus.
scenes.voiceover: Five minutes of school. That's a lot of school.

scenes.heading: How to teach Sit
steps: Hold a treat at his nose, then move it slowly up and back over his head.
The moment his bottom touches the floor, say "Yes!" and give the treat.
After a few reps, say "sit" just before the lure.
Keep sessions to 3 to 5 minutes. Puppies tire quickly.
Practice in different rooms so he learns it everywhere.
